name: Puzzles in Pinehurst 2025

venue.name: Meridian Pinehurst
venue.address: 6 Campus Way, Pinehurst Dr, Durbanville, Cape Town, 7569, South Africa

information: CubingZA is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2024 - Cape Cubes Challenge! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. Please keep in mind that we **will not** be accepting on-the-day registration. We are going to be using printed nametags and the Competition Groups website for competitor roles and duties and to do this we will need to close the registration period before the competition begins.
